title: 升降式水閘門吊裝~Vertical-lift water-gate erection
focus: 以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門~Erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks
summary: 本課以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為主線，先用矩形門葉靜水力與水壓中心與輪載界定水力與構造條件，再將上提力與水動力、鋼索彈性與行程連結到洩量率定與交接。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks through Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force and Pressure center and wheel reactions, then connects Hoisting force and hydraulic load and Rope elasticity and travel to Discharge rating and handover. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查矩形門葉靜水力：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN；再獨立檢查水壓中心與輪載：Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m。敏感度：輪載600kN不變而滾動阻力係數由0.01增為0.03，阻力由6增至18kN；此增量應連結實測輪軸狀態，不能把所有阻力都以同一固定係數涵蓋。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 將定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. Independently examine Pressure center and wheel reactions: Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m. Sensitivity: for a600kN wheel load, increasing the rolling-resistance coefficient from0.01 to0.03 raises resistance from6 to18kN. Relate this change to observed wheel conditions instead of assigning one coefficient to every resistance mechanism. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Use the following independent check: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 矩形門葉靜水力~Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force
units.title: 矩形門葉靜水力~Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force
units.mechanism: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。 驗證時應核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case. With water on both sides or partial immersion, integrate each pressure field and obtain the net action instead of using full upstream load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Diagnose it by the following check: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力~Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf
units.practice: 交接時以核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 水壓中心與輪載~Pressure center and wheel reactions
units.title: 水壓中心與輪載~Pressure center and wheel reactions
units.mechanism: 三角水壓的作用點位於水面下三分之二水深，支承反力需用力與力矩平衡共同分配。平均分配輪載只有在幾何與剛度對稱且荷載位置匹配時才成立；導軌不平整還會使部分輪失去接觸並集中負荷。 驗證時應量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力，並辨識以下失效情境：部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The triangular pressure resultant acts two-thirds of the depth below the surface. Allocate reactions using both force and moment equilibrium. Equal wheel sharing requires compatible geometry, stiffness and load position; uneven guides can unload some wheels and concentrate demand on others. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An unloaded wheel transfers its intended share to the wheels still in contact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An unloaded wheel transfers its intended share to the wheels still in contact. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~An unloaded wheel transfers its intended share to the wheels still in contact. Diagnose it by the following check: Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 水壓合力一定作用在幾何中心深度~The hydrostatic resultant always acts at geometric middepth
units.practice: 交接時以量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An unloaded wheel transfers its intended share to the wheels still in contact. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 門槽平行與淨距~Guide parallelism and clearance
units.title: 門槽平行與淨距~Guide parallelism and clearance
units.mechanism: 導軌間距沿高度的變化會影響門葉行走，局部過窄可能卡阻，過寬則改變輪緣與密封接觸。幾何淨距只是裝配檢查，尚需考慮溫度、受水壓撓曲及施工偏差；不能只量上下兩點就宣稱全行程平行。 驗證時應沿全高度分站量測導軌淨距並檢查受荷後變形，並辨識以下失效情境：中段局部收窄可能在端點量測正常時仍造成卡門。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Guide spacing along the travel path affects movement. A narrow point can bind while excessive clearance changes flange and seal contact. Geometric clearance is only an assembly check; thermal movement, pressure deflection and local construction deviations require measurements throughout the travel rather than at two endpoints. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey guide clearance at multiple elevations and inspect deformation under load. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A local midheight narrowing can bind a gate despite correct endpoint readings. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：GuideClearWidth=6020 mm; movingAssemblyWidth=6008 mm; totalClearance=6020-6008=12 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: GuideClearWidth=6020 mm; movingAssemblyWidth=6008 mm; totalClearance=6020-6008=12 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A local midheight narrowing can bind a gate despite correct endpoint readings. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

units.anchor: 輪組滾動與阻力~Wheel rolling and resistance
units.title: 輪組滾動與阻力~Wheel rolling and resistance
units.mechanism: 輪組應以滾動降低啟閉阻力，但軸承損傷、輪緣摩擦與軌道錯位會引入滑動或偏載。用等效滾動係數只描述已知狀態的總阻力，不能把轉不動的輪仍當正常滾動；要比較輪轉速、行程與驅動負荷。 驗證時應同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Wheels reduce operating resistance through rolling, but bearing damage, flange rubbing and misalignment introduce sliding and eccentric load. An equivalent coefficient describes a known state only. A seized wheel cannot still be modeled as normal rolling; compare rotation, travel and drive demand. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：totalNormalWheelLoad=600 kN; equivalentRollingCoefficient=0.015; resistance=600*0.015=9 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: totalNormalWheelLoad=600 kN; equivalentRollingCoefficient=0.015; resistance=600*0.015=9 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. units.anchor: 上提力與水動力~Hoisting force and hydraulic load
units.title: 上提力與水動力~Hoisting force and hydraulic load
units.mechanism: 上提需求包括自重、浮力、密封摩擦及水流造成的上下吸力，項目方向要在同一自由體圖列明。把已知分量代數相加可示範平衡，但動水吸力隨開度與下游邊界改變；不能以空載試車推定所有通水工況。 驗證時應在不同開度同步記錄吊點力兩側水位及密封接觸，並辨識以下失效情境：空載運轉正常仍可能在部分開度出現大下吸力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Hoisting demand includes weight, buoyancy, seal friction and flow-induced vertical force. Show directions in one free-body diagram. Adding prescribed components illustrates equilibrium, while hydrodynamic downpull changes with opening and tailwater. Dry travel tests therefore cannot establish every wet operating condition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record lifting force, both water levels and seal contact at several openings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Normal dry operation can coexist with strong downpull at partial opening. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：weight=300 kN; buoyancy=40 kN; sealFriction=25 kN; downpull=60 kN; liftDemand=300-40+25+60=345 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: weight=300 kN; buoyancy=40 kN; sealFriction=25 kN; downpull=60 kN; liftDemand=300-40+25+60=345 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 雙吊點分載偏心~Twin pick-point eccentricity

Inspect leakage location and contact patterns instead of judging performance by total flow alone. units.anchor: 停止距離與限位~Stopping distance and limits
units.title: 停止距離與限位~Stopping distance and limits
units.mechanism: 限位開關與控制系統需考慮訊號延遲及機械減速，停止位置不會等於發出命令的瞬間位置。定減速算例僅是理想運動學，實際煞車能力與負荷方向、摩擦及故障狀態相關；需以核准程序做量測，不能靠猜測保留距離。 驗證時應記錄限位觸發時間實際速度與停止位置並核對重複性，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略控制延遲會低估到達硬止擋前所需距離。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Limit systems must account for signal latency and mechanical deceleration. A command position is not the final stop position. Constant-deceleration kinematics is an idealization; brake response varies with load direction, friction and faults and must be measured within an approved test procedure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record limit-trigger time, actual speed and stop position and check repeatability. units.anchor: 洩量率定與交接~Discharge rating and handover
units.title: 洩量率定與交接~Discharge rating and handover
units.mechanism: 閘門開度不是流量本身，兩側水位、收縮係數與淹沒會共同控制洩量。自由孔流算例只示範特定工況，不適用所有開度與尾水；交接應包含實測率定、位置校正及異常訊號的追查方式，使操作資料與實體閘門一致。 驗證時應將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表，並辨識以下失效情境：位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Opening is not discharge: heads, contraction and submergence control the relation. A free-orifice example covers one condition, not every opening or tailwater. Handover should include measured ratings, position calibration and anomaly tracing so operational records correspond to the installed gate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 美國陸軍工兵團水工鋼構設計手冊
sources.titleEn: USACE design of hydraulic steel structures
sources.scope: 官方索引核實EM1110-2-2107及2022年出版日期；PDF直接取回受限，僅用可查證索引與主題，不聲稱讀過全文。
sources.scopeEn: Official index verifies EM1110-2-2107 and its 2022 publication; direct PDF access was restricted, so full-text review is not claimed.

sources.title: 美國陸軍工兵團壩安全技術入口
sources.scope: 官方入口列有垂直升降閘門EM1110-2-2701等技術資料，作為閘門查核脈絡。
sources.scopeEn: Official portal lists Vertical Lift Gates EM1110-2-2701 and related resources for gate-verification context.

sources.title: 胡佛壩業主工程與歷史入口
sources.titleEn: Hoover Dam owner engineering and history portal
sources.scope: 業主公開工程、歷史及水務資料入口；本課以水工系統作比較，不主張每種工法在此使用。
sources.scopeEn: Owner portal for engineering, history and water operations; a hydraulic-system comparison, not an assertion that every method is used there.

sources.title: 格倫峽谷壩業主資料
sources.scope: 業主資料確認壩、進水、壓力管與溢洪道的系統脈絡；不採公開庫容當本課合成模型的輸入。
sources.scopeEn: Owner information confirms dam, intake, penstock and spillway context; public storage figures are not inputs to synthetic lesson models.
